verdict.rationale: Honeycomb, an observability SaaS rather than an agent, documents an official Honeycomb MCP Server. Its docs cover a configuration guide for connecting any MCP-capable agent, a tools reference (discovery, query, trace, Board, Trigger, SLO, Canvas) and use cases, and a community report confirms engineers use Honeycomb's MCP server as an agent tool source. Missing for 10: specific setup and authentication details (transport, auth method, supported clients) are not quoted in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Honeycomb to any AI agent that supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so it can query your telemetry, investigate issues, and answer questions using your live Honeycomb data.
Connect your AI agent to the Honeycomb MCP Server.
Reference for the tools Honeycomb MCP exposes to AI agents, including discovery, query, trace, Board, Trigger, SLO, and Canvas investigation tools.
An LLM agent given tool calls for each source, including Honeycomb's MCP server, can generate integrated hypotheses.
